    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.supplier_lead_time() =====
    # ID: F0219 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:969-994
    # ROLE: Empirical supplier lead time from SAP receipt history: predicted = contract + mean observed delay; p90 = contract + p90 delay.
    # INPUTS:
    #   supplier: str, material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> contract_lead_time_days, receipts, mean_delay_days, predicted_lead_time_days, p90_lead_time_days, on_time_pct, confidence.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0105 create_app.poc_forecast_lead_time() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0411 SapRepository.supplier() (calls)
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def supplier_lead_time(self, supplier: str, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Empirical lead-time forecast from SAP receipt history (promised vs received dates), never from an LLM.
        predicted = contract lead time + mean observed delay; p90 = contract + 90th-percentile delay."""
        master = self.sap.supplier(supplier)
        if material:
            self.sap.validate_codes(material=material)
        receipts = [h for h in self.sap.section("po_history") if h["supplier"] == master["name"] and (not material or h["material"] == material)]
        delays = sorted((date.fromisoformat(h["received_date"]) - date.fromisoformat(h["promised_date"])).days for h in receipts)
        contract = float(master["contract_lead_time_days"])
        if delays:
            mean = sum(delays) / len(delays)
            p90 = delays[min(len(delays) - 1, math.ceil(0.9 * len(delays)) - 1)]
            on_time = 100 * sum(d <= 0 for d in delays) / len(delays)
        else:
            # Chained assignment: both 0.0.
            mean = p90 = 0.0
            on_time = None
        confidence = "low" if len(delays) < 3 else "medium" if len(delays) < 8 else "high"
        return {
            "use_case": "supplier_lead_time", "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "supplier": master["name"], "code": master["code"],
            "material": material, "contract_lead_time_days": contract, "receipts": len(delays),
            # Early deliveries (negative delays) never shorten the prediction below the contract lead time.
            "mean_delay_days": round(mean, 1), "predicted_lead_time_days": round(contract + max(mean, 0.0), 1),
            "p90_lead_time_days": round(contract + max(p90, 0), 1), "on_time_pct": None if on_time is None else round(on_time, 1),
            "delays_days": delays, "confidence": confidence,
            "method": "empirical: contract lead time + observed delay distribution from SAP receipts (po_history)",
            "proposed_actions": [],
        }

    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.sales_outlook() =====
    # ID: F0220 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:996-1045
    # ROLE: Sales rates per product and DC (last 7 / 28 days vs 14-day forecast, trend) and a calendar of predicted stock-outs,
    #       below-safety dates, shipment arrivals and production landings within the horizon.
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None, horizon_days: int (60).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> sales_rates[], calendar[], end, model_scope.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0060 create_app.sales_outlook() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    #   <- F0945 test_outlook_sales_rates_and_calendar() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0212 SupplyChainEngine.product_360() (calls)
    #   -> F0209 SupplyChainEngine.forecast_vs_actuals() (calls)
    def sales_outlook(self, material: str | None = None, horizon_days: int = 60) -> dict:
        """Current sales rates per product and DC (last 7 / 28 days vs the 14-day forecast) and a calendar of predicted
        stock-out and below-safety dates, with the resupply arrivals that should prevent them."""
        if material:
            self.sap.validate_codes(material=material)
        as_of = self.sap.as_of
        goods = [m for m in self.sap.section("materials") if m["type"] == "FG" and (not material or m["code"] == material)]
        dc_codes = set(self._warehouses())
        rates, events = [], []
        for good in goods:
            p = self.product_360(good["code"], horizon_days=horizon_days)
            for d in p["warehouses"]:
                if not d["daily_demand"]:
                    continue
                history = self.forecast_vs_actuals(good["code"], d["warehouse"])
                actual = [pt["value"] for pt in history["actual"]]
                last7 = sum(actual[-7:]) / len(actual[-7:])
                last28 = sum(actual[-28:]) / len(actual[-28:])
                next14 = d["forecast_14d"] / 14
                trend = round(100 * (last7 / last28 - 1), 1) if last28 else 0.0
                rates.append({"material": good["code"], "description": good["description"], "warehouse": d["warehouse"], "name": d["name"],
                              "last_7d_per_day": round(last7, 1), "last_28d_per_day": round(last28, 1), "forecast_14d_per_day": round(next14, 1),
                              "trend_pct": trend, "trend": "up" if trend > 5 else "down" if trend < -5 else "flat",
                              "sparkline": [round(v, 1) for v in actual[-28:]], "days_to_stockout": d["days_to_stockout"], "on_hand": d["on_hand"]})
                for kind, day in (("stockout", d["stockout_date"]), ("below_safety", d["below_safety_date"])):
                    if day and not (kind == "below_safety" and day == d["stockout_date"]):
                        donor = d.get("best_donor")
                        events.append({"date": day, "kind": kind, "material": good["code"], "description": good["description"], "warehouse": d["warehouse"],
                                       "days_from_today": (date.fromisoformat(day) - as_of).days,
                                       "fix": (f"transfer {donor['quantity']:,.0f} from {donor['from']} (arrives {donor['arrives']})" if donor else "pull production forward")})
            for s in self.sap.section("shipments"):
                if s["material"] == good["code"] and s["status"] in ("in_transit", "planned") and s["to"] in dc_codes:  # resupply only, not customer deliveries
                    eta = date.fromisoformat(s["eta"]) + timedelta(days=int(s.get("delay_days") or 0))
                    events.append({"date": max(eta, as_of).isoformat(), "kind": "arrival", "material": good["code"], "description": good["description"],
                                   "warehouse": s["to"], "days_from_today": max(0, (eta - as_of).days),
                                   "fix": f"shipment {s['shipment']}: {float(s['quantity']):,.0f} units{' (delayed ' + str(s['delay_days']) + ' d)' if s.get('delay_days') else ''}"})
            for o in self.sap.section("production_orders"):
                if o["material"] == good["code"]:
                    lands = date.fromisoformat(o["finish_date"]) + timedelta(days=3)
                    events.append({"date": max(lands, as_of).isoformat(), "kind": "production", "material": good["code"], "description": good["description"],
                                   "warehouse": "all DCs", "days_from_today": max(0, (lands - as_of).days),
                                   "fix": f"production order {o['order']}: {float(o['quantity']):,.0f} units from {o['plant']}"})
        events = [e for e in events if e["days_from_today"] <= horizon_days]
        order = {"stockout": 0, "below_safety": 1, "arrival": 2, "production": 3}
        events.sort(key=lambda e: (e["date"], order[e["kind"]], e["material"], e["warehouse"]))
        return {"as_of": as_of.isoformat(), "horizon_days": horizon_days,
                "end": (as_of + timedelta(days=horizon_days)).isoformat(),
                "sales_rates": sorted(rates, key=lambda r: (r["days_to_stockout"] if r["days_to_stockout"] is not None else 999, r["material"])),
                "calendar": events,
                "model_scope": "sales history is synthetic POC data; replace with approved SAP billing history before production"}

    # --------------------------------------------------- 12. warehouse / site 360
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.sites() =====
    # ID: F0221 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1048-1056
    # ROLE: List of sites with manager contact, stock value and number of positions below target.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    #   <- F0062 create_app.sites() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    def sites(self) -> list[dict]:
        out = []
        for plant in self.sap.section("plants"):
            positions = [r for r in self.position_health() if r["location"] == plant["code"]]
            primary = next((c for c in plant.get("contacts", []) if c.get("primary")), None)
            out.append({"code": plant["code"], "name": plant["name"], "type": plant["type"], "country": plant["country"],
                        "manager": primary, "stock_value_eur": round(sum(r["stock_value_eur"] for r in positions), 2),
                        "below_target": sum(r["shortfall"] > 0 for r in positions), "positions": len(positions)})
        return out

    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.site_360() =====
    # ID: F0222 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1058-1119
    # ROLE: Everything about one site: positions, shipments in/out, stocktake, expiry, lanes, and KPIs; DCs also get products, sales
    #       orders and transfers; plants get production orders, quality lots and purchase orders.
    # INPUTS:
    #   code: str (plant / DC code).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> kind "warehouse" | "plant", kpis, ...
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0063 create_app.site() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0409 SapRepository.validate_codes() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0204 SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0212 SupplyChainEngine.product_360() (calls)
    #   -> F0198 SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0208 SupplyChainEngine.production_overview() (calls)
    def site_360(self, code: str) -> dict:
        self.sap.validate_codes(plant=code)
        plant = next(p for p in self.sap.section("plants") if p["code"] == code)
        is_dc = plant["type"] == "warehouse"
        positions = [r for r in self.position_health() if r["location"] == code]
        logistics = self.logistics_status()
        inbound = [s for s in logistics["shipments"] if s["to"] == code]
        outbound = [s for s in logistics["shipments"] if s["from"] == code]
        counts = [c for c in self.stocktake_reconciliation()["counts"] if c["plant"] == code]
        expiry = [r for r in self.expiry_risk(180) if r["plant"] == code]
        lanes = [lane for lane in self.sap.section("lanes") if code in (lane["from"], lane["to"])]
        accurate = sum(c["status"] in ("matched", "within_tolerance") for c in counts)
        site = {k: plant.get(k) for k in ("code", "name", "type", "country", "address", "timezone", "operating_hours", "contacts", "contacts_note")}
        base = {"site": site, "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "positions": positions, "inbound_shipments": inbound, "outbound_shipments": outbound,
                "stocktake": counts, "expiry": expiry, "lanes": lanes}
        if is_dc:
            products, transfers = [], []
            for good in (m for m in self.sap.section("materials") if m["type"] == "FG"):
                p = self.product_360(good["code"])
                d = next(w for w in p["warehouses"] if w["warehouse"] == code)
                rank = next(r["rank"] for r in p["warehouse_ranking"] if r["warehouse"] == code)
                products.append({"material": good["code"], "description": good["description"], "rank_in_network": rank, "network_dcs": len(p["warehouses"]),
                                 **{k: d[k] for k in ("on_hand", "in_transit", "from_planned_production", "daily_demand", "sales_days_of_cover", "days_to_stockout",
                                                      "stockout_date", "below_safety_date", "surplus_14d", "health", "best_donor")}})
                for t in self.stock_balance(good["code"])["proposed_actions"]:
                    if code in (t["from"], t["to"]):
                        transfers.append({**t, "material": good["code"], "direction": "in" if t["to"] == code else "out"})
            orders = [o for o in self.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"] if o["warehouse"] == code]
            soonest = min((p for p in products if p["days_to_stockout"] is not None), key=lambda p: p["days_to_stockout"], default=None)
            ordered = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in orders)
            kpis = [
                {"label": "Stock on hand", "value": sum(p["on_hand"] for p in products), "status": "info", "hint": f"{len(products)} finished goods"},
                {"label": "Stock value", "value": round(sum(r["stock_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "info"},
                {"label": "Products at risk (≤ 14 d)", "value": sum(1 for p in products if p["days_to_stockout"] is not None and p["days_to_stockout"] <= 14),
                 "status": "critical" if soonest and soonest["days_to_stockout"] <= 14 else "good"},
                {"label": "First out-of-stock in", "value": soonest["days_to_stockout"] if soonest else None, "unit": " d",
                 "status": "critical" if soonest and soonest["days_to_stockout"] <= 7 else "warning" if soonest else "good",
                 "hint": f"{soonest['material']} on {soonest['stockout_date']}" if soonest else "none within 60 days"},
                {"label": "Open sales orders", "value": len(orders), "status": "info", "hint": f"{ordered:,.0f} units"},
                {"label": "Order fill rate", "value": round(100 * sum(float(o["confirmed"]) for o in orders) / ordered, 1) if ordered else 100.0, "unit": "%",
                 "status": "good" if all(o["status"] == "on_track" for o in orders) else "warning"},
                {"label": "Inbound shipments", "value": len(inbound), "status": "warning" if any(s.get("delay_days") for s in inbound) else "info",
                 "hint": f"{sum(1 for s in inbound if s.get('delay_days'))} delayed"},
                {"label": "Count accuracy", "value": round(100 * accurate / len(counts), 1) if counts else None, "unit": "%", "status": "warning" if counts and accurate < len(counts) else "good",
                 "hint": f"{len(counts)} counts"},
                {"label": "Expiring ≤ 180 days", "value": round(sum(r["value_eur"] for r in expiry)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning" if expiry else "good"},
            ]
            return {**base, "kind": "warehouse", "kpis": kpis, "products": products, "sales_orders": orders, "transfers": transfers}
        orders = [o for o in self.production_overview()["orders"] if o["plant"] == code]
        quality = [lot for lot in self.sap.section("quality_lots") if lot["plant"] == code]
        open_pos = [po for po in self.sap.section("purchase_orders") if po["plant"] == code]
        kpis = [
            {"label": "Components below target", "value": sum(r["shortfall"] > 0 for r in positions), "status": "warning", "hint": f"of {len(positions)} stocked components"},
            {"label": "Stock value", "value": round(sum(r["stock_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "info"},
            {"label": "Production orders", "value": len(orders), "status": "info", "hint": f"{sum(o['quantity'] for o in orders):,.0f} units"},
            {"label": "Not ready / at risk", "value": sum(o["readiness"] != "ready" for o in orders), "status": "critical" if any(o["readiness"] != "ready" for o in orders) else "good"},
            {"label": "Lots in QM / blocked", "value": sum(lot["status"] in ("inspection", "blocked") for lot in quality), "status": "warning"},
            {"label": "Open purchase orders", "value": len(open_pos), "status": "info", "hint": f"{sum(po.get('status') != 'confirmed' for po in open_pos)} unconfirmed"},
            {"label": "Count accuracy", "value": round(100 * accurate / len(counts), 1) if counts else None, "unit": "%", "status": "warning" if counts and accurate < len(counts) else "good"},
            {"label": "Expiring ≤ 180 days", "value": round(sum(r["value_eur"] for r in expiry)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning" if expiry else "good"},
        ]
        return {**base, "kind": "plant", "kpis": kpis, "production_orders": orders, "quality_lots": quality, "purchase_orders": open_pos}

    # --------------------------------------------------- 13. network map & supplier geography
    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.supplier_tier() =====
    # ID: F0223 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1122-1127
    # ROLE: Supplier tier relative to a plant: local (same country), regional (same zone), international.
    # INPUTS:
    #   supplier_country: str, supplier_zone: str, plant: dict.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   str.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   (none found)
    @staticmethod
    def supplier_tier(supplier_country: str, supplier_zone: str, plant: dict) -> str:
        """local = same country as the plant; regional = same geographic zone; international = otherwise."""
        if supplier_country == plant["country"]:
            return "local"
        return "regional" if supplier_zone == plant.get("zone") else "international"

    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.network_map() =====
    # ID: F0224 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1129-1209
    # ROLE: Data of the network map: sites, suppliers (risk, learned vs SAP lead time, tiers), quoted alternatives, tier-2 origins,
    #       flows (supply, tier2, distribution, lanes, shipments), sourcing share per factory by tier, and a tier summary.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0035 create_app.network_map() (calls)
    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    #   <- F0966 test_network_map_tiers_and_sourcing() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   -> F0221 SupplyChainEngine.sites() (calls)
    #   -> F0223 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_tier() (calls)
    #   -> F0406 SapRepository.has() (calls)
    #   -> F0204 SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def network_map(self) -> dict:
        plants = {p["code"]: p for p in self.sap.section("plants")}
        bom = self.sap.section("bom")
        scorecard = {s["supplier"]: s for s in self.supplier_scorecard()["suppliers"]}
        site_rows = {s["code"]: s for s in self.sites()}
        sites = [{**{k: p.get(k) for k in ("code", "name", "type", "lat", "lon", "city", "country", "zone")},
                  "stock_value_eur": site_rows[p["code"]]["stock_value_eur"], "below_target": site_rows[p["code"]]["below_target"],
                  "manager": site_rows[p["code"]]["manager"]} for p in plants.values()]
        suppliers, flows = [], []
        price = {s["name"]: s.get("unit_price_eur") for s in self.sap.section("suppliers")}
        for s in self.sap.section("suppliers"):
            sc = scorecard[s["name"]]
            serves = sorted({b["plant"] for b in bom if b["component"] in s["materials"]})
            country, zone = s.get("manufacturing_country", s["country"]), s.get("zone")
            served = [{"plant": code, "tier": self.supplier_tier(country, zone, plants[code])} for code in serves]
            learned = round(s["contract_lead_time_days"] + (sc["average_delay_days"] or 0), 1)
            suppliers.append({"name": s["name"], "code": s["code"], "lat": s.get("lat"), "lon": s.get("lon"), "city": s.get("city"), "country": country,
                              "zone": zone, "manufacturing_site": s.get("manufacturing_site"), "materials": s["materials"], "risk_rating": sc["risk_rating"],
                              "risk_score": sc["risk_score"], "otif_pct": sc["otif_pct"], "sap_lead_time_days": s["contract_lead_time_days"],
                              "learned_time_to_deliver_days": learned, "learned_vs_sap_days": round(learned - s["contract_lead_time_days"], 1),
                              "single_source": sc["single_source"], "serves": served,
                              # Worst (most distant) tier: max by position in the ordered list.
                              "worst_tier": max((x["tier"] for x in served), key=["local", "regional", "international"].index, default="regional")})
            for x in served:
                p = plants[x["plant"]]
                flows.append({"kind": "supply", "tier": x["tier"], "status": sc["risk_rating"], "from": [s.get("lat"), s.get("lon")], "to": [p.get("lat"), p.get("lon")],
                              "label": f"{s['name']} → {x['plant']} · {', '.join(m for m in s['materials'])} · {x['tier']} · actual {learned} d vs SAP {s['contract_lead_time_days']} d"})
        alternatives = [q for q in (self.sap.section("supplier_quotes") if self.sap.has("supplier_quotes") else []) if q.get("lat") is not None]
        origins = self.sap.section("ingredient_origins") if self.sap.has("ingredient_origins") else []
        by_name = {s["name"]: s for s in suppliers}
        for o in origins:
            target = by_name.get(o["feeds_supplier"])
            if target:
                flows.append({"kind": "tier2", "tier": "international", "status": o["criticality"], "from": [o["lat"], o["lon"]], "to": [target["lat"], target["lon"]],
                              "label": f"{o['ingredient']} ({o['origin']}) → {o['feeds_supplier']} · {o['transit_days']}±{o['transit_variability_days']} d"})
        for factory in (p for p in plants.values() if p["type"] != "warehouse"):
            for dc in (p for p in plants.values() if p["type"] == "warehouse"):
                flows.append({"kind": "distribution", "tier": None, "status": "info", "from": [factory.get("lat"), factory.get("lon")], "to": [dc.get("lat"), dc.get("lon")],
                              "label": f"{factory['code']} → {dc['code']} finished goods"})
        for lane in self.sap.section("lanes"):
            # Draw each bidirectional lane once (string comparison picks one direction).
            if lane["from"] < lane["to"]:
                a, b = plants[lane["from"]], plants[lane["to"]]
                flows.append({"kind": "lane", "tier": None, "status": "info", "from": [a.get("lat"), a.get("lon")], "to": [b.get("lat"), b.get("lon")],
                              "label": f"{lane['from']} ↔ {lane['to']} · {lane['lead_days']} d · €{lane['cost_per_unit']}/unit"})
        codes = {s["code"]: s for s in self.sap.section("suppliers")}
        for sh in self.logistics_status()["shipments"]:
            src = plants.get(sh["from"]) or codes.get(sh["from"])
            dst = plants.get(sh["to"])
            if src and dst and sh["status"] in ("in_transit", "planned"):
                late = f" · {sh['delay_days']} d late" if sh.get("delay_days") else ""
                flows.append({"kind": "shipment", "tier": None, "status": "critical" if sh["escalate"] else "warning" if sh.get("delay_days") else "good",
                              "from": [src.get("lat"), src.get("lon")], "to": [dst.get("lat"), dst.get("lon")],
                              "label": f"{sh['shipment']} {sh['quantity']:,.0f} {sh['material']} via {sh['carrier']} · ETA {sh['revised_eta']}{late}"})

        # L'Oréal-style sourcing KPI per factory: share of spend (open + last 6 months of POs) by supplier tier
        spend: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
        po_rows = [(po["supplier"], po["plant"], float(po["quantity"])) for po in self.sap.section("purchase_orders")]
        for h in self.sap.section("po_history"):
            plants_using = sorted({b["plant"] for b in bom if b["component"] == h["material"]})
            # Historical quantities are split evenly between the plants that use the material.
            for code in plants_using:
                po_rows.append((h["supplier"], code, float(h["quantity_ordered"]) / len(plants_using)))
        tier_of = {(s["name"], x["plant"]): x["tier"] for s in suppliers for x in s["serves"]}
        for supplier, plant_code, qty in po_rows:
            tier = tier_of.get((supplier, plant_code)) or self.supplier_tier(by_name[supplier]["country"], by_name[supplier]["zone"], plants[plant_code])
            spend.setdefault(plant_code, {}).setdefault(tier, 0.0)
            spend[plant_code][tier] += qty * float(price.get(supplier) or 0)
        factory_sourcing = []
        for code, tiers in sorted(spend.items()):
            total = sum(tiers.values()) or 1
            factory_sourcing.append({"plant": code, "name": plants[code]["name"], "zone": plants[code].get("zone"), "spend_eur": round(total, 2),
                                     **{f"{t}_pct": round(100 * tiers.get(t, 0) / total, 1) for t in ("local", "regional", "international")},
                                     "within_zone_pct": round(100 * (tiers.get("local", 0) + tiers.get("regional", 0)) / total, 1)})
        tier_summary = []
        for tier in ("local", "regional", "international"):
            group = [s for s in suppliers if s["worst_tier"] == tier]
            tier_summary.append({"tier": tier, "suppliers": len(group), "names": [s["name"] for s in group],
                                 "avg_learned_time_to_deliver_days": round(sum(s["learned_time_to_deliver_days"] for s in group) / len(group), 1) if group else None,
                                 "avg_otif_pct": round(sum(s["otif_pct"] or 0 for s in group) / len(group), 1) if group else None,
                                 "avg_delay_vs_sap_days": round(sum(s["learned_vs_sap_days"] for s in group) / len(group), 1) if group else None})
        return {"as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "sites": sites, "suppliers": suppliers, "alternatives": alternatives, "origins": origins, "flows": flows,
                "factory_sourcing": factory_sourcing, "tier_summary": tier_summary,
                "reference": self.sap.section("sourcing_reference") if self.sap.has("sourcing_reference") else None}

    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() =====
    # ID: F0225 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1211-1221
    # ROLE: Stock rows expiring within `within_days` (or already expired), with value and state, most urgent first.
    # INPUTS:
    #   within_days: int (180).
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    #   <- F0237 Dashboards._inventory() (calls)
    #   <- F0222 SupplyChainEngine.site_360() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def expiry_risk(self, within_days: int = 180) -> list[dict]:
        rows = []
        for row in self.sap.section("stock"):
            if not row.get("expiry"):
                continue
            days_left = (date.fromisoformat(row["expiry"]) - self.sap.as_of).days
            if days_left <= within_days:
                cost = float(self.sap.material(row["material"])["unit_cost"])
                rows.append({**row, "days_left": days_left, "value_eur": round(float(row["quantity"]) * cost, 2),
                             "state": "expired" if days_left < 0 else "critical" if days_left <= 90 else "warning"})
        return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r["days_left"])

    # ===== FUNCTION: SupplyChainEngine.kpis() =====
    # ID: F0226 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/engine.py:1223-1248
    # ROLE: Network KPIs: inventory value, at-risk positions (< 7 days of cover), open POs / production orders, open quality lots,
    #       delayed shipments, supplier count.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0075 create_app.kpis() (calls)
    #   <- F0932 test_inventory_and_kpis() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0195 SupplyChainEngine._warehouses() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0413 SapRepository.on_hand() (calls)
    #   -> F0404 SapRepository.as_of() (references)
    def kpis(self) -> dict:
        warehouses = self._warehouses()
        finished_goods = [row for row in self.sap.section("materials") if row["type"] == "FG"]
        inventory_value = 0.0
        risks = []
        for material in finished_goods:
            for warehouse in warehouses:
                qty = self.sap.on_hand(warehouse, material["code"])
                inventory_value += qty * float(material["unit_cost"])
                demand = self.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")[material["code"]][warehouse]
                cover = qty / demand
                if cover < 7:
                    risks.append({"severity": "high" if cover < 4 else "medium", "warehouse": warehouse, "material": material["code"], "days_of_cover": round(cover, 1)})
        lots = self.sap.section("quality_lots")
        return {
            "as_of": self.sap.as_of.isoformat(),
            "inventory_value": round(inventory_value, 2),
            "at_risk_positions": risks,
            "at_risk_count": len(risks),
            "open_purchase_orders": len(self.sap.section("purchase_orders")),
            "open_production_orders": len(self.sap.section("production_orders")),
            "quality_lots_open": sum(1 for lot in lots if lot["status"] in ("inspection", "blocked")),
            "shipments_delayed": sum(1 for s in self.sap.section("shipments") if s.get("delay_days")),
            "suppliers": len(self.sap.section("suppliers")),
            "currency": "EUR",
        }

# ===== FUNCTION: _status_cover() =====
# ID: F0227 · function · used (framework)
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:28-31
# ROLE: Colour of a coverage percentage: < 60% critical, < 100% warning, else good.

#   pct: float | None.

#   <- F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)

def _status_cover(pct: float | None) -> str:
    if pct is None:
        return "info"
    return "critical" if pct < 60 else "warning" if pct < 100 else "good"

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards.product_scope() =====
    # ID: F0231 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:42-49
    # ROLE: The product scope: a finished good plus its BOM components (None = the whole network).
    # INPUTS:
    #   material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   set[str] | None (ValueError when the material is not a finished good).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0232 Dashboards.build() (calls)
    #   <- F0261 RoleCenter._facts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    def product_scope(self, material: str | None) -> set[str] | None:
        """A finished good plus its BOM components; None means the whole network."""
        if not material:
            return None
        master = self.engine.sap.material(material)
        if master["type"] != "FG":
            raise ValueError(f"{material} is not a finished good")
        # Set union of {material} and the set comprehension of its components.
        return {material} | {b["component"] for b in self.engine.sap.section("bom") if b["parent"] == material}

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards.build() =====
    # ID: F0232 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:51-59
    # ROLE: Build one persona dashboard by dispatching to _<persona>(scope, material).
    # INPUTS:
    #   persona: str (key of PERSONAS), material: str | None.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> persona, title, task, as_of, product focus, kpis, charts, tables (+ forecast / analysis).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0065 create_app.dashboard() (calls)
    #   <- F0280 RoleCenter._charts() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0231 Dashboards.product_scope() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def build(self, persona: str, material: str | None = None) -> dict:
        if persona not in PERSONAS:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown dashboard {persona}. Options: {', '.join(PERSONAS)}")
        scope = self.product_scope(material)
        body = getattr(self, f"_{persona}")(scope, material)
        focus = None
        if material:
            focus = {"material": material, "description": self.engine.sap.material(material)["description"], "scope": sorted(scope)}
        return {"persona": persona, **PERSONAS[persona], "as_of": self.engine.sap.as_of.isoformat(), "product": focus, **body}

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------- shared
    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._understock_chart() =====
    # ID: F0233 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:62-68
    # ROLE: Chart of the 10 most understocked positions (lowest coverage %, then largest shortfall value).
    # INPUTS:
    #   rows: list[dict] (position_health rows), title: str.

    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0227 _status_cover() (calls)
    def _understock_chart(self, rows: list[dict], title: str) -> dict:
        top = sorted((r for r in rows if r["shortfall"] > 0), key=lambda r: (r["coverage_pct"] or 0, -r["shortfall_value_eur"]))[:10]

                "rows": [{"label": f"{r['material']} @ {r['location']}", "value": r["coverage_pct"], "status": _status_cover(r["coverage_pct"]),
                          "hint": f"{r['description']}: {r['on_hand']:,.0f} on hand + {r['inbound']:,.0f} inbound vs target {r['target']:,.0f} {r['uom']} · short {r['shortfall']:,.0f} (€{r['shortfall_value_eur']:,.0f})"}
                         for r in top]}

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._supplier_rows() =====

    def _supplier_rows(self, scope) -> list[dict]:
        rows = []

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._mentions() =====
    # ID: F0235 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:81-86
    # ROLE: Does an insight mention a material of the scope (code or description) anywhere in its text, evidence or action?
    # INPUTS:
    #   insight: dict, scope.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   bool.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def _mentions(self, insight: dict, scope) -> bool:
        if scope is None:
            return True
        text = insight["title"] + insight["detail"] + json.dumps(insight["evidence"]) + json.dumps(insight["action"])
        names = {self.engine.sap.material(code)["description"] for code in scope}
        return any(token in text for token in scope | names)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ personas
    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._executive() =====
    # ID: F0236 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:89-120
    # ROLE: Executive dashboard: critical insights, fill rate, value short, expiring stock, decisions waiting / executed; insights by
    #       area, recommendation pipeline, understocked positions; top priorities table.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
    #   -> F0235 Dashboards._mentions() (calls)
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0389 Store.counts() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)
    def _executive(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        insights = [i for i in self.insights.insights() if self._mentions(i, scope)]
        positions = [r for r in self.engine.position_health() if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        orders = [o for o in self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"] if _in(scope, o["material"])]
        counts = self.store.counts(self.engine.sap.snapshot["id"])["recommendations"]  # this customer only
        qty = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in orders)
        fill = 100 * sum(float(o["confirmed"]) for o in orders) / qty if qty else 100
        value_at_risk = sum(r["shortfall_value_eur"] for r in positions)
        expiring = sum(r["value_eur"] for r in self.engine.expiry_risk(90) if _in(scope, r["material"]))
        cats = Counter((i["category"], i["severity"]) for i in insights)
        categories = sorted({c for c, _ in cats})
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Critical insights", "value": sum(i["severity"] == "critical" for i in insights), "status": "critical", "hint": "needs action today"},
                {"label": "Order fill rate", "value": round(fill, 1), "unit": "%", "status": "good" if fill >= 98 else "warning", "hint": "confirmed / ordered, open orders"},
                {"label": "Value short vs target", "value": round(value_at_risk), "unit": "€", "status": "warning", "hint": "positions in scope, at cost"},
                {"label": "Stock expiring ≤ 90 days", "value": round(expiring), "unit": "€", "status": "warning" if expiring else "good"},
                {"label": "Awaiting your decision", "value": counts.get("pending_review", 0), "status": "info", "hint": "this customer"},
                {"label": "Executed in SAP sandbox", "value": counts.get("executed", 0), "status": "good", "hint": "this customer"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                {"id": "insights", "type": "stacked", "title": "Open insights by area", "subtitle": "deterministic, from the SAP snapshot",
                 "series": ["critical", "warning", "info"], "status_series": True,
                 "rows": [{"label": c, "segments": [{"name": s, "value": cats.get((c, s), 0)} for s in ("critical", "warning", "info")]} for c in categories]},
                {"id": "decisions", "type": "bar", "title": "Recommendation pipeline", "subtitle": "agent / planner proposals → manager decision → SAP sandbox",
                 "unit": "", "rows": [{"label": s.replace("_", " "), "value": counts.get(s, 0), "status": {"rejected": "critical", "executed": "good"}.get(s, "info")}
                                      for s in ("pending_review", "accepted", "executed", "rejected")]},
                self._understock_chart(positions, "Top 10 understocked positions"),
            ],
            "tables": [{"title": "Top priorities", "columns": ["Severity", "Area", "Insight"],
                        "rows": [[i["severity"], i["category"], i["title"]] for i in insights[:8]]}],
        }

    # ID: F0237 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:122-155
    # ROLE: Inventory dashboard: positions below target, stock-out risk, inventory / excess / expiring value; understock, days of cover,
    #       surplus-gap (stock balance of the focus product) and shelf-life charts; forecast chart reference.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0210 SupplyChainEngine.position_health() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    #   -> F0225 SupplyChainEngine.expiry_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0198 SupplyChainEngine.stock_balance() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)
    #   -> F0410 SapRepository.material() (calls)
    def _inventory(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        positions = [r for r in self.engine.position_health() if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        fg = [r for r in positions if r["material_type"] == "FG"]
        expiry = [r for r in self.engine.expiry_risk(180) if _in(scope, r["material"])]
        # Default focus: the finished good with the lowest days of cover anywhere (works for every customer's catalogue)
        focus = material or min(fg, key=lambda r: r["days_of_cover"] if r["days_of_cover"] is not None else 1e9)["material"]
        balance = self.engine.stock_balance(focus)
        demand = self.engine.sap.section("warehouse_demand_daily")[focus]
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Positions below target", "value": sum(r["shortfall"] > 0 for r in positions), "status": "warning", "hint": f"of {len(positions)} material × location"},
                {"label": "Stock-out risk (< 7 days)", "value": sum((r["days_of_cover"] or 99) < 7 for r in fg), "status": "critical"},
                {"label": "Inventory value", "value": round(sum(r["stock_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "info"},
                {"label": "Excess stock (> 2× target)", "value": round(sum(r["excess_value_eur"] for r in positions)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning", "hint": "cash tied up"},
                {"label": "Expiring ≤ 180 days", "value": round(sum(r["value_eur"] for r in expiry)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                self._understock_chart(positions, "Top 10 understocked products" if scope is None else "Understocked positions (product + components)"),
                {"id": "cover", "type": "bar", "title": "Days of cover — finished goods by DC", "subtitle": "on hand ÷ daily demand; alert below 7 days",
                 "unit": " d", "reference": 7, "reference_label": "7-day alert",
                 "rows": [{"label": f"{r['material']} @ {r['location']}", "value": r["days_of_cover"],
                           "status": "critical" if r["days_of_cover"] < 4 else "warning" if r["days_of_cover"] < 7 else "good",
                           "hint": f"{r['on_hand']:,.0f} units, {r['requirement'] / 14:,.0f}/day"} for r in sorted(fg, key=lambda r: r["days_of_cover"])]},
                {"id": "gap", "type": "diverging", "title": f"{self.engine.sap.material(focus)['description']}: surplus (+) / gap (−) vs target by DC",
                 "subtitle": "XGBoost 14-day forecast + safety stock; OR-Tools moves surplus to gaps",
                 "unit": " units", "rows": [{"label": p["warehouse"], "value": p["surplus_or_gap"]} for p in balance["positions"]]},
                {"id": "expiry", "type": "bar", "title": "Shelf-life risk: batches expiring within 180 days", "subtitle": "days left; value at cost in the hint",
                 "unit": " d", "rows": [{"label": f"{r['batch']} · {r['material']} @ {r['plant']}", "value": r["days_left"],
                                         "status": "critical" if r["state"] != "warning" else "warning",
                                         "hint": f"{r['quantity']:,.0f} units, €{r['value_eur']:,.0f}, expires {r['expiry']}"} for r in expiry]},
            ],
            # The UI loads the forecast-vs-actuals chart of the focus product at its highest-demand DC.
            "forecast": {"material": focus, "warehouse": max(demand, key=lambda wh: float(demand[wh]))},
            "tables": [],
        }

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._sales() =====
    # ID: F0238 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:157-191
    # ROLE: Sales-order desk: open / at-risk / inbound-dependent orders, fill rate, value at risk, fixable by transfer; quantity by
    #       status and fill-rate charts; orders and resolutions table.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    def _sales(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        result = self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment()
        orders = [o for o in result["orders"] if _in(scope, o["material"])]
        actions = [a for a in result["proposed_actions"] if _in(scope, a.get("material"))]
        qty = sum(float(o["quantity"]) for o in orders)
        fill = 100 * sum(float(o["confirmed"]) for o in orders) / qty if qty else 100
        cost = {m["code"]: float(m["unit_cost"]) for m in self.engine.sap.section("materials")}
        by_status = Counter(o["status"] for o in orders)
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Open sales orders", "value": len(orders), "status": "info"},
                {"label": "At risk", "value": by_status.get("at_risk", 0), "status": "critical"},
                {"label": "Depends on inbound", "value": by_status.get("depends_on_inbound", 0), "status": "warning"},
                {"label": "Fill rate", "value": round(fill, 1), "unit": "%", "status": "good" if fill >= 98 else "warning"},
                {"label": "Value at risk", "value": round(sum(o["shortfall"] * cost[o["material"]] for o in orders)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning"},
                {"label": "Fixable by transfer", "value": sum(1 for a in actions if a["action"] == "stock_transfer"), "status": "good"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                {"id": "orders", "type": "stacked", "title": "Order quantity by status and warehouse", "subtitle": "confirmed vs shortfall, units",
                 "series": ["confirmed", "shortfall"],
                 "rows": [{"label": wh, "segments": [{"name": "confirmed", "value": sum(o["confirmed"] for o in orders if o["warehouse"] == wh)},
                                                      {"name": "shortfall", "value": sum(o["shortfall"] for o in orders if o["warehouse"] == wh)}]}
                          for wh in sorted({o["warehouse"] for o in orders})]},
                {"id": "fill", "type": "bar", "title": "Fill rate by order", "subtitle": "confirmed ÷ ordered by requested date", "unit": "%", "reference": 100,
                 "rows": [{"label": f"{o['order']} · {o['customer']}", "value": round(100 * o["confirmed"] / o["quantity"], 1),
                           "status": {"at_risk": "critical", "depends_on_inbound": "warning"}.get(o["status"], "good"),
                           "hint": f"due {o['requested_date']} · {o['priority']} priority · {o['quantity']:,.0f} {o['material']} from {o['warehouse']}"} for o in orders]},
            ],
            "tables": [{"title": "Orders and resolutions", "columns": ["Order", "Customer", "Due", "Qty", "Confirmed", "Status", "Resolution"],
                        "rows": [[o["order"], o["customer"], o["requested_date"], o["quantity"], o["confirmed"], o["status"],

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._stocktake() =====
    # ID: F0239 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:193-221
    # ROLE: Stocktake control: counts, record accuracy, explained / to investigate, difference value; explained-vs-unexplained and
    #       difference-value charts; reconciliation table with evidence.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   (none found)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    #   -> F0228 _in() (calls)
    def _stocktake(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        result = self.engine.stocktake_reconciliation()
        counts = [c for c in result["counts"] if _in(scope, c["material"])]
        accurate = sum(c["status"] in ("matched", "within_tolerance") for c in counts)
        investigate = sum(c["status"] == "investigate" for c in counts)
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Counts", "value": len(counts), "status": "info"},
                {"label": "Inventory record accuracy", "value": round(100 * accurate / len(counts), 1) if counts else 100, "unit": "%",
                 "status": "warning", "hint": "matched or within tolerance before posting"},
                {"label": "Explained automatically", "value": sum(c["status"] == "explained" for c in counts), "status": "good"},
                {"label": "To investigate", "value": investigate, "status": "critical" if investigate else "good"},
                {"label": "Absolute difference value", "value": round(sum(c["difference_value_eur"] for c in counts)), "unit": "€", "status": "warning"},
            ],
            "charts": [
                {"id": "explained", "type": "stacked", "title": "Count differences: explained vs unexplained", "subtitle": "absolute units by count",
                 "series": ["explained", "unexplained"],
                 "rows": [{"label": f"{c['material']} @ {c['plant']}", "segments": [{"name": "explained", "value": abs(c["explained"])},
                                                                                    {"name": "unexplained", "value": abs(c["unexplained"])}]}
                          for c in counts if c["difference"]]},
                {"id": "diffvalue", "type": "diverging", "title": "Difference value by count (€)", "subtitle": "counted − book, at cost", "unit": " €",
                 "rows": [{"label": f"{c['material']} @ {c['plant']}", "value": c["difference_value_eur"] if c["difference"] >= 0 else -c["difference_value_eur"]} for c in counts]},
            ],
            "tables": [{"title": "Reconciliation with evidence", "columns": ["Count", "Location", "Material", "Book", "Counted", "Diff", "Status", "Evidence", "Recommendation"],
                        "rows": [[c["count_id"], c["plant"], c["material"], c["book_quantity"], c["counted_quantity"], c["difference"], c["status"],

                                  (c["recommendation"] or {}).get("action", "—").replace("_", " ")] for c in counts]}],

    # ===== FUNCTION: Dashboards._production() =====
    # ID: F0241 · method · used (framework)
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/dashboards.py:257-281
    # ROLE: Production dashboard: orders ready / at risk, stock held in QM; component-readiness and component-shortage (21-day) charts;
    #       quality lots affecting production.
    # INPUTS:
    #   scope, material.
    # OUTPUT:

    #   -> F0203 SupplyChainEngine.quality_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0233 Dashboards._understock_chart() (calls)
    def _production(self, scope, material) -> dict:
        orders = [o for o in self.engine.production_overview()["orders"] if _in(scope, o["material"])]
        positions = [r for r in self.engine.position_health(21) if r["location_type"] != "warehouse" and _in(scope, r["material"])]
        quality = self.engine.quality_status()
        lots = {lot["lot"]: lot for lot in quality["lots"]}
        impacts = [i for i in quality["production_impacts"] if _in(scope, i["finished_good"])]
        held = sum(float(lot["quantity"]) for lot in quality["lots"] if lot["status"] in ("inspection", "blocked") and _in(scope, lot["material"]))
        return {
            "kpis": [
                {"label": "Production orders", "value": len(orders), "status": "info"},
                {"label": "Ready", "value": sum(o["readiness"] == "ready" for o in orders), "status": "good"},
                {"label": "At risk / not ready", "value": sum(o["readiness"] != "ready" for o in orders), "status": "critical"},

            "charts": [

# ===== FUNCTION: _id() =====
# ID: F0243 · function · used
# ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/insights.py:15-16
# ROLE: Stable insight id from its parts ("IN-" + 10 hex chars): the same situation always gets the same id.
# INPUTS:
#   *parts -> any values.
# OUTPUT:
#   str.
# CALLED BY:
#   <- F0248 InsightEngine.insights() (calls)
# CALLS:
#   (none found)
def _id(*parts) -> str:
    # map(str, parts) converts each part to text before joining.
    return "IN-" + hashlib.sha1("|".join(map(str, parts)).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]

    # ===== FUNCTION: InsightEngine.insights() =====
    # ID: F0248 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/insights.py:30-130
    # ROLE: All insights: stock-out / overstock positions, sales orders at risk, production readiness, high-risk suppliers, escalated
    #       shipments, stocktake differences — each with severity, category, title, detail, metric, evidence, UI action and a
    #       suggested copilot question; sorted by severity then category.
    # INPUTS:
    #   self.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   list[dict].
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0236 Dashboards._executive() (calls)
    #   <- F0066 create_app.get_insights() (calls)
    #   <- F0934 test_insights_are_plain_english_deterministic_and_sorted() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0205 SupplyChainEngine.inventory_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0405 SapRepository.snapshot() (references)
    #   -> F0243 _id() (calls)
    #   -> F0246 InsightEngine._plant() (calls)
    #   -> F0247 InsightEngine._mat() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0208 SupplyChainEngine.production_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0202 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_scorecard() (calls)
    #   -> F0204 SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() (calls)
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    def insights(self) -> list[dict]:
        out: list[dict] = []
        # Bound method alias: add(x) == out.append(x).
        add = out.append

        # Stock-out and overstock risk by warehouse position
        for p in self.engine.inventory_overview()["positions"]:
            cover, wh, mat = p["days_of_cover"], p["warehouse"], p["material"]
            evidence = [{"label": "On hand", "value": p["on_hand"]}, {"label": "Daily demand", "value": p["daily_demand"]},
                        {"label": "Open sales orders", "value": p["open_sales_orders"]}, {"label": "In transit (14 d)", "value": p["in_transit_14d"]},
                        {"label": "Source", "value": f"SAP snapshot {self.sap.snapshot['id']} · A_MaterialStock, A_SalesOrderItem, A_Shipment"}]
            # Rule: < 7 days of cover = risk (critical < 4); > 30 days = likely donor.
            if cover < 7:
                add({"id": _id("stockout", wh, mat), "severity": "critical" if cover < 4 else "warning", "category": "Inventory",
                     # ":g" formats a number without trailing zeros.
                     "title": f"{self._plant(wh)} has about {cover:g} days of {self._mat(mat)} left",
                     "detail": f"{p['on_hand']:,.0f} units on hand against {p['daily_demand']:,.0f}/day demand and {p['open_sales_orders']:,.0f} units "
                               f"on open sales orders; {p['in_transit_14d']:,.0f} units are in transit.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days of cover", "value": cover}, "evidence": evidence,
                     "action": {"label": "Rebalance stock", "kind": "stock_balance", "params": {"material": mat, "warehouse": wh}},
                     "ask": f"How should we rebalance {mat} to protect {wh}?"})
            elif cover > 30:
                add({"id": _id("overstock", wh, mat), "severity": "info", "category": "Inventory",
                     "title": f"{self._plant(wh)} holds {cover:g} days of {self._mat(mat)} — a likely transfer donor",
                     "detail": f"{p['on_hand']:,.0f} units on hand for {p['daily_demand']:,.0f}/day demand.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days of cover", "value": cover}, "evidence": evidence,
                     "action": {"label": "Rebalance stock", "kind": "stock_balance", "params": {"material": mat, "warehouse": wh}},
                     "ask": f"Can {wh} supply other DCs with {mat}?"})

        # Sales orders
        for o in self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment()["orders"]:
            if o["status"] == "on_track":
                continue
            fix = o["resolution"] or {}
            fix_text = (f" Fix: transfer {fix['quantity']:,.0f} from {fix['from']} (arrives {fix['arrives']}, €{fix['estimated_cost']:,.0f})."
                        if fix.get("action") == "stock_transfer" else " No DC can cover it in time — propose a partial delivery." if fix else "")
            add({"id": _id("so", o["order"]), "severity": "critical" if o["status"] == "at_risk" else "warning", "category": "Sales orders",
                 "title": (f"Order {o['order']} for {o['customer']} is short by {o['shortfall']:,.0f} units" if o["status"] == "at_risk"
                           else f"Order {o['order']} for {o['customer']} depends on stock still in transit"),
                 "detail": f"{o['quantity']:,.0f} × {self._mat(o['material'])} from {o['warehouse']} due {o['requested_date']} ({o['priority']} priority); "
                           f"{o['available_by_due_date']:,.0f} available by then.{fix_text}",
                 "metric": {"label": "shortfall", "value": o["shortfall"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Sales order", "value": o["order"]}, {"label": "Requested", "value": o["requested_date"]},
                              {"label": "Confirmed", "value": o["confirmed"]}, {"label": "Source", "value": "A_SalesOrderItem, A_MaterialStock, A_Shipment, A_TransportLane"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Plan fulfilment", "kind": "sales_orders", "params": {}},
                 "ask": f"How do we fulfil sales order {o['order']} on time?"})

        # Production readiness
        for o in self.engine.production_overview()["orders"]:
            if o["readiness"] == "ready":
                continue
            add({"id": _id("prod", o["order"]), "severity": "critical" if o["readiness"] == "not_ready" else "warning", "category": "Production",
                 "title": f"Production order {o['order']} ({self._mat(o['material'])}, {self._plant(o['plant'])}) is {o['readiness'].replace('_', ' ')}",
                 "detail": f"{o['quantity']:,.0f} units due {o['finish_date']}; short: {', '.join(o['short_components'])}. "
                           f"{o['component_readiness_pct']}% of components are covered.",
                 "metric": {"label": "components covered", "value": f"{o['component_readiness_pct']}%"},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Order", "value": o["order"]}, {"label": "Short components", "value": ", ".join(o["short_components"])},
                              {"label": "Rule", "value": "SOP SC-104: unrestricted stock + confirmed POs by need date"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Check readiness", "kind": "factory_readiness",
                            "params": {"plant": o["plant"], "material": o["material"], "quantity": o["quantity"], "need_by": o["finish_date"]}},
                 "ask": f"Can {o['plant']} produce {o['quantity']:g} {o['material']} by {o['finish_date']}?"})

        # Suppliers
        for s in self.engine.supplier_scorecard()["suppliers"]:
            if s["risk_rating"] != "high":
                continue
            add({"id": _id("supplier", s["supplier"]), "severity": "warning", "category": "Suppliers",
                 "title": f"{s['supplier']} is a high continuity risk",
                 "detail": f"OTIF {s['otif_pct']}%, average delay {s['average_delay_days']} days, rejects {s['quality_reject_pct']}%"
                           f"{', single source' if s['single_source'] else ''}; €{s['open_po_exposure_eur']:,.0f} open PO exposure.",
                 "metric": {"label": "risk score", "value": s["risk_score"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "OTIF", "value": f"{s['otif_pct']}%"}, {"label": "Reject rate", "value": f"{s['quality_reject_pct']}%"},
                              {"label": "Source", "value": "A_PurchaseOrderHistory, A_InspectionLot, supplier contracts"}],
                 "action": {"label": "Research supplier", "kind": "supplier", "params": {"supplier": s["supplier"]}},
                 "ask": f"Is {s['supplier']} a continuity risk? Cite the contract."})

        # Logistics
        for s in self.engine.logistics_status()["shipments"]:
            if s.get("escalate"):
                add({"id": _id("ship", s["shipment"]), "severity": "warning", "category": "Logistics",
                     "title": f"Shipment {s['shipment']} to {s['to']} is {s['delay_days']} days late",
                     "detail": f"{s['quantity']:,.0f} × {self._mat(s['material'])} via {s['carrier']} ({s['mode']}); revised ETA {s['revised_eta']}. "
                               f"Reason: {s['delay_reason']}.",
                     "metric": {"label": "days late", "value": s["delay_days"]},
                     "evidence": [{"label": "Carrier SLA policy", "value": "LP-05: delays above SLA trigger a claim review"}],
                     "action": {"label": "View shipments", "kind": "suppliers", "params": {}},
                     "ask": f"What is the impact of the delay on shipment {s['shipment']}?"})

        # Stocktake
        for c in self.engine.stocktake_reconciliation()["counts"]:
            if c["status"] in ("matched",):
                continue
            sev = "warning" if c["status"] == "investigate" else "info"
            # ":+g" shows the sign (+ or -).
            why = "; ".join(f"{e['type'].replace('_', ' ')} {e['document']} ({e['quantity']:+g})" for e in c["evidence"]) or "no movement explains it"
            add({"id": _id("count", c["count_id"]), "severity": sev, "category": "Stocktake",
                 "title": f"Count difference of {c['difference']:+g} for {c['material']} at {c['plant']} — {c['status'].replace('_', ' ')}",
                 "detail": f"Book {c['book_quantity']:,.0f}, counted {c['counted_quantity']:,.0f} (€{c['difference_value_eur']:,.0f}). Explanation: {why}.",
                 "metric": {"label": "unexplained", "value": c["unexplained"]},
                 "evidence": [{"label": "Count", "value": c["count_id"]}] + [{"label": e["type"], "value": f"{e['document']} {e['quantity']:+g}"} for e in c["evidence"]],
                 "action": {"label": "Reconcile", "kind": "stocktake", "params": {}},
                 "ask": f"Why is there a stock count difference for {c['material']} at {c['plant']}?"})

        out.sort(key=lambda i: (SEVERITY_ORDER[i["severity"]], i["category"]))
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ watches
    # ===== FUNCTION: InsightEngine.evaluate() =====
    # ID: F0249 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/insights.py:133-154
    # ROLE: Evaluate one watch (alert rule) of a given kind against the current snapshot.
    # INPUTS:
    #   kind: str (see WATCH_KINDS), params: dict, threshold: float.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"value", "triggered": bool, "text"} (ValueError for an unknown kind; StopIteration -> unknown code).
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0069 create_app.create_watch() (calls)
    #   <- F0071 create_app.evaluate_watches() (calls)
    #   <- F0939 test_watch_evaluation() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0205 SupplyChainEngine.inventory_overview() (calls)
    #   -> F0201 SupplyChainEngine.supplier_risk() (calls)
    #   -> F0206 SupplyChainEngine.sales_order_fulfilment() (calls)
    #   -> F0207 SupplyChainEngine.stocktake_reconciliation() (calls)
    #   -> F0204 SupplyChainEngine.logistics_status() (calls)
    def evaluate(self, kind: str, params: dict, threshold: float) -> dict:
        if kind == "days_of_cover":
            pos = next(p for p in self.engine.inventory_overview(params["material"])["positions"] if p["warehouse"] == params["warehouse"])
            value = pos["days_of_cover"]
            return {"value": value, "triggered": value < threshold, "text": f"{params['warehouse']} {params['material']}: {value:g} days of cover (alert below {threshold:g})"}
        if kind == "supplier_risk":
            risk = self.engine.supplier_risk(params["supplier"])
            value = risk["risk_score"]
            return {"value": value, "triggered": value >= threshold, "text": f"{risk['supplier']['name']}: risk score {value:g} (alert at {threshold:g})"}
        if kind == "sales_orders_at_risk":
            value = self.engine.sales_order_fulfilment(params.get("warehouse") or None)["at_risk"]
            return {"value": value, "triggered": value >= threshold, "text": f"{value} sales order(s) at risk (alert at {threshold:g})"}
        if kind == "stocktake_unexplained":
            value = self.engine.stocktake_reconciliation()["to_investigate"]
            return {"value": value, "triggered": value >= threshold, "text": f"{value} count difference(s) need investigation"}
        if kind == "shipment_delay":
            ships = [s for s in self.engine.logistics_status(params.get("warehouse") or None)["shipments"]]
            value = max((int(s.get("delay_days") or 0) for s in ships), default=0)
            return {"value": value, "triggered": value > threshold, "text": f"longest delay {value} days (alert above {threshold:g})"}
        if kind == "question":
            return {"value": None, "triggered": False, "text": "Saved question — run it with the copilot"}
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown watch kind {kind}")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- consent gate
    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.consent() =====
    # ID: F0252 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:48-54
    # ROLE: Consent of a tenant to industry learning: a recorded decision wins; otherwise synthetic demo customers are opted in and the
    #       primary customer is opted out.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> {"tenant", "industry_learning": bool, "source"}.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0058 create_app.moat_consent() (calls)
    #   <- F0254 MoatEngine.model_comparison() (calls)
    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0384 Store.consent() (calls)
    def consent(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        """Recorded consent wins; without a record, synthetic demo customers are opted in and real ones are opted out."""
        row = self.store.consent(tenant_id)
        if row:
            return {"tenant": tenant_id, "industry_learning": row["industry_learning"], "source": f"recorded by {row['updated_by']} {row['updated_at'][:10]}"}
        synthetic = tenant_id != DEFAULT_TENANT  # the generated demo customers; the primary customer starts opted out
        return {"tenant": tenant_id, "industry_learning": bool(synthetic), "source": "default: synthetic demo customer (simulated consent)" if synthetic else "default: not shared"}

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- model comparison
    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.model_comparison() =====
    # ID: F0254 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:61-89
    # ROLE: Demand-weighted WAPE of customer-only XGBoost vs naive baseline vs generic (all consenting customers) vs industry (same
    #       industry, + own history if this customer consents) vs cold start.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict -> customer_only_wape, baseline_wape, generic_wape, industry_wape, cold_start_wape, participants, notes.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0255 MoatEngine.view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0393 TenantRegistry.get() (calls)
    #   -> F0253 MoatEngine._series() (calls)
    #   -> F0529 evaluate_models() (calls)
    #   -> F0252 MoatEngine.consent() (calls)
    #   -> F0530 pooled_evaluation() (calls)
    def model_comparison(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        ctx = self.registry.get(tenant_id)
        target = self._series(tenant_id)
        evals = [evaluate_models(b) for b in target]
        weight = sum(target) or 1
        # Weighted average of per-series WAPE by demand volume.
        customer_only = sum(e["model"]["wape_pct"] * b for e, b in zip(evals, target, strict=True)) / weight
        baseline = sum(e["baseline"]["wape_pct"] * b for e, b in zip(evals, target, strict=True)) / weight
        others = [t for t in self.registry.files if t != tenant_id]
        # CONSENT GATE: only customers that agreed can contribute their data.
        consenting = [t for t in others if self.consent(t)["industry_learning"]]
        same_industry = [t for t in consenting if self.registry.get(t).industry == ctx.industry]
        own_consent = self.consent(tenant_id)["industry_learning"]
        donors = lambda ids: tuple(sorted(b for t in ids for b in self._series(t)))  # noqa: E731
        generic = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(consenting), False) if consenting else None
        industry = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(same_industry), own_consent) if same_industry else None
        cold = pooled_evaluation(target, donors(same_industry), False, scale_by_history=False) if same_industry else None
        wape = lambda r: None if r is None else r["wape_pct"]  # noqa: E731
        return {
            "customer_only_wape": round(customer_only, 2), "baseline_wape": round(baseline, 2),
            "generic_wape": wape(generic), "industry_wape": wape(industry), "cold_start_wape": wape(cold),
            "participants": {"industry": ctx.industry, "same_industry_consenting": same_industry, "all_consenting": len(consenting),
                             "this_customer_contributes": own_consent},
            "notes": [
                "Customer-only = XGBoost per series on this customer's history; baseline = same weekday last week.",
                "Generic = one model trained on every consenting customer of every industry (not this customer), scaled to this customer's demand level.",
                f"Industry = consenting {ctx.industry_label} customers" + (" plus this customer's history" if own_consent else " (this customer does not contribute)") + ".",
                "Cold start = industry model with none of this customer's history, scaled by its planned daily demand (a newly onboarded customer).",
                "Caution: the demo histories are synthetic and share one seasonal shape, which flatters pooled models; real customers differ, so validate on real holdouts before promoting an industry model.",
            ],
        }

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- the view
    # ===== FUNCTION: MoatEngine.view() =====
    # ID: F0255 · method · used
    # ORIGINAL FILE: backend/app/moat.py:92-179
    # ROLE: The full moat page: value proposition, evidence per moat, flywheel stage counts, the five moat metrics, model comparison,
    #       consent of this and peer customers, verified value by benefit line, ownership, decisions and outcomes.
    # INPUTS:
    #   tenant_id: str.
    # OUTPUT:
    #   dict.
    # CALLED BY:
    #   <- F0057 create_app.moat_view() (calls)
    # CALLS:
    #   -> F0393 TenantRegistry.get() (calls)
    #   -> F0405 SapRepository.snapshot() (references)
    #   -> F0290 RoleCenter.learning() (calls)
    #   -> F0388 Store.decision_stats() (calls)
    #   -> F0380 Store.list_outcomes() (calls)
    #   -> F0367 Store.list_recommendations() (calls)
    #   -> F0254 MoatEngine.model_comparison() (calls)
    #   -> F0252 MoatEngine.consent() (calls)
    #   -> F0407 SapRepository.section() (calls)
    #   -> F0406 SapRepository.has() (calls)
    #   -> F0224 SupplyChainEngine.network_map() (calls)
    #   -> F0253 MoatEngine._series() (calls)
    def view(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
        ctx = self.registry.get(tenant_id)
        sap, engine, roles = ctx.sap, ctx.engine, ctx.roles
        snapshot = sap.snapshot["id"]
        learning = roles.learning()
        s = learning["summary"]
        decisions = self.store.decision_stats(snapshot)
        outcomes = self.store.list_outcomes(snapshot)
        recs = self.store.list_recommendations(snapshot_id=snapshot)
        kinds = {r["id"]: r["kind"] for r in recs}
        models = self.model_comparison(tenant_id)
        consent = self.consent(tenant_id)

        # 1. evidence per data moat
        records = sum(len(sap.section(k)) for k in ("sales_orders", "purchase_orders", "po_history", "stock", "production_orders", "shipments", "quality_lots", "stocktake_counts", "goods_movements") if sap.has(k))
        net = engine.network_map()
        gaps = sorted(net["suppliers"], key=lambda x: -(x["learned_vs_sap_days"] or 0))
        reality = [f"{x['name']}: SAP promises {x['sap_lead_time_days']} d, actually {x['learned_time_to_deliver_days']:g} d" for x in gaps if (x["learned_vs_sap_days"] or 0) > 0][:3]
        lanes = sap.section("lanes")
        evidence = {
            "erp_history": {"value": f"{records} SAP records · {len(self._series(tenant_id))} demand series × 180 days",
                            "learned": f"forecast WAPE {models['customer_only_wape']}% vs {models['baseline_wape']}% for the simple baseline"},
            "supplier_reality": {"value": f"{len(sap.section('po_history'))} receipts from {len(net['suppliers'])} suppliers",
                                 "learned": "; ".join(reality) or "suppliers deliver on promise"},
            "human_expertise": {"value": f"{decisions['decided']} decisions · {decisions['modified']} modified · {decisions['rejected']} rejected",
                                "learned": (", ".join(f"{k.replace('_', ' ')} ×{v}" for k, v in decisions["reason_codes"].items()) or "no override reasons recorded yet")},
            "verified_outcomes": {"value": f"{s['observed']} of {s['executed']} executed decisions observed in SAP",
                                  "learned": f"{s['achieved_pct']}% achieved · €{s['realized_impact_eur']:,.0f} realised" if s["observed"] else "awaiting the first observed outcome"},
            "operating_knowledge": {"value": f"{len(sap.section('bom'))} BOM rules · {len(lanes)} transfer lanes · {len(sap.section('plants'))} sites with contacts",
                                    "learned": "constraints used by every optimisation (lanes, BOM, safety stock, quality status)"},
            "industry_learning": {"value": f"{len(models['participants']['same_industry_consenting'])} other consenting {ctx.industry_label} customer(s)",
                                  "learned": ("industry model WAPE " + (f"{models['industry_wape']}%" if models["industry_wape"] is not None else "n/a") +
                                              f" vs customer-only {models['customer_only_wape']}%")},
        }
        moats = [{"id": mid, "name": name, "learns": learns, "potential": potential, **evidence[mid]} for mid, name, learns, potential in MOAT_POTENTIAL]

        # 2. flywheel stages with live counts
        labels = [o for o in outcomes if o["status"] != "awaiting_observation"]
        flywheel = [
            {"stage": "Private customer data", "detail": "SAP · suppliers · inventory · demand · production", "count": records, "unit": "records"},
            {"stage": "AI prediction & optimisation", "detail": "forecast shortages, compare suppliers, recommend replenishment",
             "count": self.store.counts(snapshot)["analyses"], "unit": "analyses"},
            {"stage": "Real human decisions", "detail": "approve · modify · reject · explain why", "count": decisions["decided"], "unit": "decisions"},
            {"stage": "Verified business outcomes", "detail": "actual delivery · costs · delays · stock-outs · quality", "count": len(labels), "unit": "outcomes"},
            {"stage": "Supervised learning + MLOps", "detail": "validated labels → better datasets → evaluated models", "count": len(labels), "unit": "validated labels",
             "extra": f"{len(learning['models'])} models evaluated on holdout"},
        ]

        # 3. value realised so far, by benefit line (verified outcomes only)
        realised: dict[str, float] = {}
        for o in outcomes:
            if o["achieved"] and o["realized_impact_eur"]:
                line = VALUE_LINES.get(kinds.get(o["recommendation_id"], ""), "Faster planning")
                realised[line] = realised.get(line, 0) + o["realized_impact_eur"]

        # 4. the five moat-strength metrics
        uplift = None if models["baseline_wape"] == 0 else round(100 * (1 - models["customer_only_wape"] / models["baseline_wape"]), 1)
        personal = None if models["generic_wape"] is None else round(models["generic_wape"] - models["customer_only_wape"], 2)
        industry_adv = None if models["industry_wape"] is None else round(models["customer_only_wape"] - models["industry_wape"], 2)
        metrics = [
            {"name": "Verified decision outcomes", "value": s["observed"], "unit": "", "display": f"{s['observed']} of {s['executed']}",
             "question": "How many AI recommendations have complete, reliable real-world result records?"},
            {"name": "Model accuracy uplift", "value": uplift, "unit": "%", "display": f"{uplift}% lower error than baseline" if uplift is not None else "—",
             "question": "How much does the trained model outperform the existing baseline?"},
            {"name": "Business value realised", "value": s["realized_impact_eur"], "unit": "€", "display": f"€{s['realized_impact_eur']:,.0f} verified",
             "question": "How much verified cost reduction or service improvement did the AI help achieve?"},
            {"name": "Customer personalisation advantage", "value": personal, "unit": " pts",
             "display": f"{personal:+} WAPE pts vs generic model" if personal is not None else "no consenting data for a generic model",
             "question": "How much better is the customer-specific model than a generic model? (+ = customer model better)"},
            {"name": "Industry learning advantage", "value": industry_adv, "unit": " pts",
             "display": (f"{industry_adv:+} WAPE pts vs customer-only; cold start {models['cold_start_wape']}%" if industry_adv is not None else "needs other consenting customers in this industry"),
             "question": "Does authorised industry data improve predictions, particularly for newly onboarded customers? (+ = industry model better)"},
        ]
        return {
            "as_of": sap.as_of.isoformat(), "tenant": tenant_id, "customer": ctx.customer, "industry": ctx.industry, "industry_label": ctx.industry_label,
            "value_proposition": {
                "title": "Turning real supply-chain experience into competitive intelligence",
                "text": ("Every customer builds its own private intelligence moat from proprietary business data, human expertise and verified "
                         "operational outcomes. With controlled, permission-based industry learning, the platform turns these experiences into "
                         "increasingly effective prediction and optimisation models across verticals."),
                "moat": "The moat is not the SAP data itself: it is the continuously validated ability to turn real business experience into better decisions.",
            },
            "moats": moats, "flywheel": flywheel, "metrics": metrics, "models": models, "consent": consent,
            "industry_customers": [{"tenant": t, "customer": self.registry.labels[t][2], **self.consent(t)} for t in self.registry.files
                                   if self.registry.labels[t][0] == ctx.industry],
            "realised_by_line": realised, "ownership": OWNERSHIP,
            "decisions": decisions, "outcomes": outcomes[:20], "data_moat": learning["data_moat"],
        }
